svg.title: Blue-Violet Curve I
svg.desc: Hand-authored interpretive SVG after direct visual inspection of the cited primary reference. Approximate contours and interpretive colors; paint texture, photographic perspective and external framing omitted. First painting from left in the explicitly captioned 1982 studio photograph. Primary blue-violet is mapped to the blue recolor family with a violet-blue default shade, so the work appears among blue paintings. Exact pigment is unmeasured. Dimensions unknown. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): source review remains unresolved for blue; prior provisional screen colors retained, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://archive.org/download/ellswo00kell/ellswo00kell.pdf#page=68; record guggenheim1996-essay-68-fig-2a; visual review 2026-10-27. Pure-vector study; not a facsimile.
